To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Karmanov wave function is able to describe the experimental data on tensor polarization of the deuteron fragmentation in a satisfactory way; the deuteron fragmentation with the large transverse momentum of the emitted nucleon is not sensitive to the deuteron wave function in a region of the small inter-nucleon distance; the deuteron wave-function in the region of large inter-nucleon distances is important for the description of the deuteron breakup in the fragmentation process.

the tensor analyzing power for the fragmentation of relativistic deuteron with large transverse momentum proton emission can be explained by Karmanov's relativistic deuteron wave function without invoking any additional degrees of freedom.
the Karmanov wave function in the deuteron rest frame is not the best choice to describe the tensor analyzing power in the fragmentation of relativistic deuteron.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possibility of the relativistic approach to the deuteron fragmentation.
the study of relativistic effects on the deuteron structure.

the description of the tensor analyzing power for the fragmentation reaction of polarized deuterons on a nucleus in terms of a relativistic wave function of a deuteron in which the nucleons are described by the Dirac equation in the light front formalism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a relativistic treatment of the deuteron fragmentation process in terms of the wave functions of the deuteron in the light-front dynamics is a promising approach for the future.

a relativistic description of deutron polarization in the framework of the quantum theory of light front, which does not involve any additional degrees of freedom, can be used to describe experimental data on tensor analyzing power of nuclear fragmentation of relativisitc deuterons with large transversal proton momentum.
the tensor analyzing power in the deuteron fragmentation is a direct manifestation of the deuteron structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Karmanov et all wave function is a good approximation for the deuteron wave function in the region of high transversal momentum of the proton.
the tensor analyzing power is a very good tool to study the structure of relativistic deuteron.
the tensor polarization of the deuteron is mainly due to the tensor polarization of proton and not due to the tensor correlation of proton and neutron.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it shows the necessity to take into account the relativistic effects in the description of the deuteron fragmentation in the kinematical region of the large transvers momentum of the proton.
the Karmanov wave function is able to reproduce all experimental data on the deuteron tensor analyzing power.
the Karmanov wave functions in the light-front dynamics can be used to describe relativistic nuclear fragmentation processes.
